meta.title: Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024
meta.attribution: Source: Probative, Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024, version 1.0.0, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845898, licensed CC BY 4.0.
meta.citation: Probative. (2026). Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024 (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845898
meta.citeAs: Probative Growth, Marriage and divorce rates by state (CDC NCHS), 1990 to 2024, 2026, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23845898
meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are provisional counts that state health departments send to NCHS, turned into rates per 1,000 residents. Divorce figures include annulments and, for some counties or states, petitions filed or legal separations. Divorce records cover the states that report divorces to NCHS: 45 states and DC in 2024.
meta.notice: Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice.

records.text: United States, 2024: 662,950 divorces and annulments reported to NCHS, 2.3 per 1,000 residents of the 45 states and DC that report them; 4.0 per 1,000 in 2000.
